LUNR.headline: Intuitive Machines, Inc. (LUNR) Reports Q3 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
LUNR.description: Intuitive Machines (LUNR) reported a Q3 loss of $0.10 per share, beating the consensus estimate of $0.12 loss, with a 16.67% earnings surprise. Revenue of $269.35 million surpassed estimates by 10.70%, up significantly from $52.44 million year-ago. However, the stock has underperformed the market, down 25% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 11.3% gain. The company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions.

AMD.headline: Xanadu Quantum Technologies: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
AMD.description: Xanadu Quantum Technologies announced progress on its photonic quantum hardware roadmap during Q3 2026 earnings, reducing optical switch loss to 7 millidecibels and expanding its software ecosystem. The company secured $140 million in nondilutive funding from Canada and increased R&D spending to $25.6 million to accelerate chip fabrication, prioritizing fault-tolerant hardware development over near-term revenue growth.

AMD.headline: ASUS Expands Access to Local AI Across DIY PCs, Gaming Systems, Creator Workstations, and Professional Desktops
AMD.description: ASUS launched the Agent Computer initiative to democratize AI access across its product ecosystem, offering AI-ready hardware ranging from DIY PC builds to enterprise supercomputers, alongside software solutions like ASUS Zenni Claw and Multi-LM Tuner. The initiative enables users to deploy AI locally, in the cloud, or through hybrid models while optimizing total cost of ownership and operations.

AMD.headline: Nvidia CEO Resigns: What It Means for Your Shares
AMD.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following controversies over personal conduct and concerns about chips reaching China through a Singapore customer. CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement. Though the stock fell 7% on the news, analysts believe the sell-off may be overdone, as Nvidia's near-term revenue is secure due to existing orders and planned products. AMD.headline: Stock Market Midday, Nov. 12: Nvidia CEO Resigns, AMD Surges as Wall Street Edges Higher
AMD.description: Major stock indexes edged higher on November 12, 2026, despite Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's immediate resignation. AMD surged following an analyst upgrade as investors see competitive opportunities from Nvidia's leadership transition. The market showed mixed performance with industrials and tech leading, while gold prices fell and Treasury yields climbed to 4.98%. Concerns about rising borrowing costs and AI infrastructure spending sustainability remain for investors.

AMD.headline: AMD is Trading at a Premium at 38.39X P/E: Is the Stock Still a Buy?
AMD.description: AMD shares have surged 123% year-to-date, trading at a premium 38.39X forward P/E versus the sector's 17.48X. Despite valuation concerns, the company's strong data center momentum—with Q3 2026 revenues jumping 97% to $8.55 billion—and expected 80%+ revenue growth in 2027 driven by AI infrastructure demand justify the elevated price. AMD receives a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

AMD.headline: Can Intel's Altera Partnership Drive Growth in Edge and Physical AI?
AMD.description: Intel has announced a strategic partnership with Altera to advance edge and physical AI solutions by combining Intel's processors and software with Altera's FPGAs. The collaboration targets healthcare, aerospace, defense, and robotics sectors with modular sensor solutions and streamlined development tools. Intel's stock has gained 64.9% over the past year, though 2026-2027 earnings estimates have declined slightly.

AMD.headline: Nvidia vs. AMD: Which Is the Better Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock for 2027 After the Tech Sell-Off?
AMD.description: Both Nvidia and AMD have experienced significant sell-offs in the semiconductor sector, but both companies show strong growth prospects for 2027. While AMD is projected to have higher EPS growth (108% vs 71%), Nvidia trades at a more attractive valuation with an 88% upside potential compared to AMD's 26%, making Nvidia the better value play despite AMD's accelerating momentum in AI chips.

AMD.headline: Breakfast News: What’s Nvidia’s Biggest Risk?
AMD.description: Nvidia faces significant leadership uncertainty as its board prepares to oust CEO Jensen Huang following revelations of affairs with individuals connected to national security concerns. The company lacks a named successor, creating key-man risk despite its AI dominance. Competitors AMD and Broadcom are gaining investor interest as potential beneficiaries. The situation parallels Apple's transition to Tim Cook, though Nvidia's lack of succession planning presents greater challenges.

AMD.headline: Forget Buying All 7 "Magnificent Seven" Stocks. Here's How to Rank 6 Top AI Stocks Right Now (Hint: It Has to Do With Anthropic.)
AMD.description: With Anthropic's IPO expected to price on November 18, 2026, the article ranks six AI and infrastructure stocks by their direct exposure to Anthropic's spending. Amazon and Alphabet have the most direct ties as investors and suppliers, while Nvidia has moderate exposure. Energy companies like Bloom Energy, Vistra, and Oklo offer indirect exposure through data center power needs.

AMD.headline: NVIDIA Gears Up for Q3 Earnings: Should Investors Buy the Stock?
AMD.description: NVIDIA is expected to report Q3 fiscal 2027 results on November 17 with revenues projected to jump 91.2% to $108.99 billion and earnings rising 91.5%. Strong demand for GPUs, generative AI, hyperscale infrastructure, and networking products should drive growth, particularly in the Data Center segment. AXTI.headline: AXTI's AI Data Center Boom: Can Substrate Demand Sustain Growth?
AXTI.description: AXT Inc. (AXTI) reported record Q3 2026 revenues of $73.4 million, up 162% year-over-year, driven by strong demand for indium phosphide (InP) substrates used in AI data center optical connectivity. The company's backlog exceeded $500 million with customers on allocation, and it surpassed its 2026 capacity doubling goal. However, the stock's valuation appears stretched at 15.14X P/S ratio compared to industry average of 8.51X.
